title: VyaparPulse Merchant Feature Record
description: One row = one merchant on one calendar day. This is the Phase 1 output contract — the 'trustworthy feature dataset' section 27 calls the most important Phase 1 deliverable. Covers every required feature listed in section 6.

daily_revenue.description: Sum of transaction amounts for this merchant on this date.

weekly_revenue.description: Trailing 7-day revenue ending on this date.

revenue_growth_pct.description: % change in weekly_revenue vs the prior 7-day window. Null when there isn't a prior window yet.

payment_collection_rate.description: amount collected / amount owed, trailing 7 days. Null when there is nothing owed yet.

outstanding_amount.description: Sum of (transaction amount - amount_paid) for still-open transactions.

outstanding_ratio.description: outstanding_amount / weekly_revenue. Not capped at 1 — accumulated debt can exceed a single week's revenue, and that's a meaningful risk signal, not an error. Null when weekly_revenue is 0.

payment_reliability.description: Share of trailing-30d transactions that reached 'paid' status.

peak_hour_revenue_share.description: Share of trailing-7d revenue earned in the single busiest hour-of-day bucket.

product_demand.description: Trailing-7d quantity sold per product, when items are itemized. Empty object if no itemized data exists yet.

revenue_volatility_7d.description: Std. deviation of daily revenue over the trailing 7 days, as a fraction of the mean (coefficient of variation). Null when there are fewer than 2 days of history.
